name: RmTabStrip
description: Modern tabs (top / left / bottom, closable, overflow arrows); children live on the pages (TabPage).

properties.name: TabPages
properties.description: Tabs: a;b;c or JSON [{Text, Name, Image}].

properties.name: SelectedIndex
properties.description: Page shown (click a tab in the designer to edit it).

properties.name: AutoClose
properties.description: The close button removes the tab (False = only TabClosing).

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Theme of this control: Inherit = the form's / application's Theme.

properties.name: EventItem
properties.description: Name of the item of the last item event (ItemClick, NodeClick ...).

properties.name: EventIndex
properties.description: Index of the item of the last item event.

events.name: TabClosing
events.description: A tab's close button was pressed (EventItem / EventIndex).

methods.name: AddTab
methods.description: Adds a tab; returns its index.

methods.name: TabCaption
methods.description: Gets / sets the caption of a tab.

python-tk.notes: also draws the control for VB6 (vb-basic) and every GUI Bridge language; native C / C++ / Fortran exes use radforms/controls/rm_*.c
